verdict.rationale: Project-local install is well evidenced: the skills installer writes editable files into your repo, and a hands-on probe installed the tdd skill into ./.claude/skills/. The docs also offer a second mode, a managed read-only plugin bundle installed via Claude Code, Codex or Copilot plugin commands. That route is plausibly user-level, but the evidence never states it applies across all projects, and no explicit scope choice (e.g. a global flag) is documented. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of user-global install scope, a documented scope-selection option, and corroboration that the plugin install applies across all projects.
